_comment: Synthetic demo data — not based on real insurer data. Lines sum = 124200 total (simulator uses sum of all lines for billed_total, not 122000). Non-payable lines 4+5+6 = 500+100+1400 = 2000. _note: The SPEC §6 worked example uses EXACTLY 5 lines totaling 122000 with room_linked=80000 (room+prof_fee only, no nursing). This fixture has nursing too, so deduction will differ.
